review.evidence: At Celo block 69291577 and Monad block 80607801: JPYm owner on both chains = Safe 0x58099B...; Celo Safe now 4/6 (one signer rotated out since prior review); Monad Safe 4/7; BorrowerOperations confirmed immutable on Celo. Monad proxy admin owned by same Safe. All addressable mint surfaces confirmed on both chains. Economic-control fields authored 2026-07-20: economicCapSemantics is unbounded because, unlike Mento V2 assets whose mint path sits behind the 48-hour Mento Timelock, the JPYm token owner is a plain 4-of-6 Safe on Celo and 4-of-7 Safe on Monad at 0x58099B74F4ACd642Da77b4B7966b4138ec5Ba458 with no modules, no guard, and no delay, so it can authorize a different minter and issue without an independently enforced bound. reconciliation is continuous because JPYm is a Mento V3 CDP whose USDm collateral is held and observable on-chain rather than in an off-chain reserve requiring periodic attestation. supervision is none: Mento operates no named prudential regulator relationship for JPYm. Upgradeability authored 2026-07-21: Celo block 72722488 confirmed the standard EIP-1967 admin and implementation storage slots are both zero (Mento StableTokenV3 uses a custom, non-EIP-1967 proxy pattern) while owner() independently resolved to the same 4-of-6 Mento Safe recorded above; the implementation address is the shared StableTokenV3 logic contract also used by the sibling CHFm deployment.
